top_news.title: Experts Rise Where LLMs Disagree: Using Cross-Model Disagreement to Target Expert Effort in LLM Codebook Revision for Large-Scale Annotation
top_news.dek: Researchers propose using cross-model disagreement to identify ambiguous data points, allowing experts to focus on refining codebooks for large-scale annotation.
top_news.brief: Developing robust codebooks for large-scale annotation is time-consuming. This study suggests using LLM disagreement to surface complex cases, enabling experts to provide targeted feedback. This approach aims to improve annotation quality and efficiency by prioritizing human effort where models struggle to reach a consensus.

top_news.title: Mercury 2.5 LLM hits 770 tokens per second
top_news.dek: The Mercury 2.5 LLM has reached a throughput of 770 tokens per second, according to the latest Artificial Analysis performance benchmarks.
top_news.brief: Artificial Analysis has updated its intelligence index to include the Mercury 2.5 model. The model demonstrates high-speed performance, hitting 770 tokens per second, and is evaluated across a suite of benchmarks including coding, reasoning, and general knowledge tasks.

top_news.title: Introducing NV-Reason-CT Open 3D CT VLM for Radiologist Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
top_news.dek: NVIDIA introduced NV-Reason-CT, a vision-language model designed for 3D CT scans to support radiologist chain-of-thought reasoning.
top_news.brief: General-purpose VLMs often struggle with volumetric medical imaging. NV-Reason-CT is specifically built to handle 3D CT data, providing the multi-step conversational depth required for radiologists to verify AI-generated findings and improve diagnostic trust.
top_news.image_alt: 3D CT scan visualization with AI analysis overlay

top_news.title: [AINews] Meta Connect 2026: Muse glasses, voice, video, and Charm
top_news.dek: Meta Connect 2026 showcased new hardware and software, including Muse glasses and updates to voice and video capabilities.
top_news.brief: Meta's latest event highlighted the success of the Muse platform, which has seen significant adoption. While specific model updates were limited, the company continues to push its hardware ecosystem, positioning Muse as a primary competitor in the consumer AI space.

top_news.title: Meta VR Glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio, Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3: Specs, Features, Prices
top_news.dek: Meta announced new smart glasses and a slimmed-down VR headset, including the company's first camera-free smart glasses.
top_news.brief: At Meta Connect, the company expanded its wearable lineup. The new hardware includes camera-free smart glasses, addressing privacy concerns while maintaining AI-integrated features. These devices represent a shift toward more discreet, everyday AI-powered hardware.

primary.title: The Drift Contract: Spectral Updates for Depth-Robust Local Learning
primary.summary: Local learning trains each layer with its own auxiliary loss and no global backward pass, which makes layer updates structurally parallel.
